steps.name: Bind trusted trigger and current main
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
test "$TARGET_REPOSITORY" = "portyu9/portyu9"
[[ "$TRUSTED_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
python3 scripts/codeql_autofix_controller.py trigger \
  --event-name "$EVENT_NAME" \
  --event-file "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH" \
  --trusted-sha "$TRUSTED_SHA" \
  --out trigger.json
gh api "repos/${TARGET_REPOSITORY}/git/ref/heads/main" > main-ref.json
python3 scripts/codeql_autofix_controller.py main \
  --ref-file main-ref.json \
  --expected-sha "$TRUSTED_SHA" \
  --out main.json
BASE_SHA="$(jq -r .baseSha main.json)"
[[ "$BASE_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
printf 'base_sha=%s\n' "$BASE_SHA" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Discover one exact-main CodeQL alert
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
gh api --paginate --slurp \
  "repos/${TARGET_REPOSITORY}/code-scanning/alerts?state=open&tool_name=CodeQL&per_page=100" \
  > alert-pages.json
python3 scripts/codeql_autofix_controller.py discover \
  --alerts-file alert-pages.json \
  --base-sha "$BASE_SHA" \
  --out discovery.json
if jq -e '.target != null' discovery.json >/dev/null; then
  jq -c '.target' discovery.json > target.json
  ALERT_NUMBER="$(jq -r .number target.json)"
  test "$ALERT_NUMBER" -gt 0
  printf 'has_target=true\n' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  printf 'alert_number=%s\n' "$ALERT_NUMBER" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  printf 'has_target=false\n' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

steps.name: Locate an existing remediation PR
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
gh api --paginate --slurp \
  "repos/${TARGET_REPOSITORY}/pulls?state=open&base=main&per_page=100" \
  > open-pr-pages.json
python3 scripts/codeql_autofix_controller.py locate \
  --prs-file open-pr-pages.json \
  --alert "$ALERT_NUMBER" \
  --out existing.json
EXISTS="$(jq -r .exists existing.json)"
test "$EXISTS" = "true" -o "$EXISTS" = "false"
printf 'exists=%s\n' "$EXISTS" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
if [ "$EXISTS" = "true" ]; then
  printf 'pr_number=%s\n' "$(jq -r .pr.prNumber existing.json)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  printf 'origin_run_id=%s\n' "$(jq -r .pr.originRunId existing.json)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  printf 'head_sha=%s\n' "$(jq -r .pr.headSha existing.json)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

steps.name: Request and inspect GitHub CodeQL Autofix
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
gh api -X POST \
  "repos/${TARGET_REPOSITORY}/code-scanning/alerts/${ALERT_NUMBER}/autofix" \
  > autofix-create.json
gh api \
  "repos/${TARGET_REPOSITORY}/code-scanning/alerts/${ALERT_NUMBER}/autofix" \
  > autofix-status.json
python3 scripts/codeql_autofix_controller.py status \
  --target-file target.json \
  --status-file autofix-status.json \
  --out normalized-autofix.json
READY="$(jq -r .ready normalized-autofix.json)"
test "$READY" = "true" -o "$READY" = "false"
printf 'ready=%s\n' "$READY" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Commit exact Autofix to a dedicated branch and open one PR
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
[[ "$BASE_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
test "$ALERT_NUMBER" -gt 0
test "$RUN_ID" -gt 0
test "$RUN_ATTEMPT" -gt 0
BRANCH="codeql-autofix/alert-${ALERT_NUMBER}/run-${RUN_ID}"
TARGET_REF="refs/heads/${BRANCH}"

if gh api "repos/${TARGET_REPOSITORY}/git/ref/heads/${BRANCH}" > existing-ref.json 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "ERROR: deterministic Autofix branch already exists without an open matching PR" >&2
  exit 1
fi

gh api -X POST "repos/${TARGET_REPOSITORY}/git/refs" \
  -f ref="$TARGET_REF" \
  -f sha="$BASE_SHA" \
  > created-ref.json
test "$(jq -r .ref created-ref.json)" = "$TARGET_REF"
test "$(jq -r .object.sha created-ref.json)" = "$BASE_SHA"

gh api -X POST \
  "repos/${TARGET_REPOSITORY}/code-scanning/alerts/${ALERT_NUMBER}/autofix/commits" \
  -f target_ref="$TARGET_REF" \
  -f message="CodeQL Autofix alert #${ALERT_NUMBER}" \
  > autofix-commit.json
python3 scripts/codeql_autofix_controller.py commit \
  --response-file autofix-commit.json \
  --branch "$BRANCH" \
  --out committed.json
HEAD_SHA="$(jq -r .headSha committed.json)"
[[ "$HEAD_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
test "$HEAD_SHA" != "$BASE_SHA"

gh api "repos/${TARGET_REPOSITORY}/compare/${BASE_SHA}...${HEAD_SHA}" > compare.json
python3 scripts/codeql_autofix_controller.py compare \
  --compare-file compare.json \
  --base-sha "$BASE_SHA" \
  --head-sha "$HEAD_SHA" \
  --out compare-proof.json

RULE_ID="$(jq -r .ruleId target.json)"
PR_BODY="Trusted GitHub CodeQL Autofix for alert #${ALERT_NUMBER} (${RULE_ID}). Generated by ${RUN_ID}; protected checks and exact-head admission remain mandatory before protected merge can be attempted."
gh api -X POST "repos/${TARGET_REPOSITORY}/pulls" \
  -f title="CodeQL Autofix alert #${ALERT_NUMBER}" \
  -f head="$BRANCH" \
  -f base="main" \
  -f body="$PR_BODY" \
  -F draft=false \
  > created-pr.json
python3 scripts/codeql_autofix_controller.py receipt \
  --run-id "$RUN_ID" \
  --run-attempt "$RUN_ATTEMPT" \
  --event-name "$EVENT_NAME" \
  --base-sha "$BASE_SHA" \
  --target-file target.json \
  --branch "$BRANCH" \
  --head-sha "$HEAD_SHA" \
  --pr-file created-pr.json \
  --out codeql-autofix-receipt.json
PR_NUMBER="$(jq -r .prNumber codeql-autofix-receipt.json)"
RECEIPT_NAME="codeql-autofix-receipt-run-${RUN_ID}-alert-${ALERT_NUMBER}"
printf 'created=true\n' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
printf 'pr_number=%s\n' "$PR_NUMBER" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
printf 'head_sha=%s\n' "$HEAD_SHA" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
printf 'receipt_name=%s\n' "$RECEIPT_NAME" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Approve exact protected checks and queue admission retry
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
test "$TARGET_REPOSITORY" = "portyu9/portyu9"
[[ "$BASE_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
[[ "$HEAD_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
test "$ALERT_NUMBER" -gt 0
test "$PR_NUMBER" -gt 0
test "$RUN_ID" -gt 0
BRANCH="codeql-autofix/alert-${ALERT_NUMBER}/run-${RUN_ID}"
test "$(gh api "repos/${TARGET_REPOSITORY}/git/ref/heads/main" --jq .object.sha)" = "$BASE_SHA"
test "$(gh api "repos/${TARGET_REPOSITORY}/git/ref/heads/${BRANCH}" --jq .object.sha)" = "$HEAD_SHA"
PR="$(gh api "repos/${TARGET_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}")"
test "$(jq -r .state <<<"$PR")" = "open"
test "$(jq -r .base.ref <<<"$PR")" = "main"
test "$(jq -r .base.sha <<<"$PR")" = "$BASE_SHA"
test "$(jq -r .head.ref <<<"$PR")" = "$BRANCH"
test "$(jq -r .head.sha <<<"$PR")" = "$HEAD_SHA"
test "$(jq -r .head.repo.full_name <<<"$PR")" = "$TARGET_REPOSITORY"

CODEQL_WORKFLOW_ID="$(gh api "repos/${TARGET_REPOSITORY}/actions/workflows/codeql.yml" --jq .id)"
DEPENDENCY_WORKFLOW_ID="$(gh api "repos/${TARGET_REPOSITORY}/actions/workflows/dependency-review.yml" --jq .id)"
PROFILE_WORKFLOW_ID="$(gh api "repos/${TARGET_REPOSITORY}/actions/workflows/profile-quality.yml" --jq .id)"
CAPABILITY_WORKFLOW_ID="$(gh api "repos/${TARGET_REPOSITORY}/actions/workflows/capability-admission.yml" --jq .id)"
for WORKFLOW_ID in "$CODEQL_WORKFLOW_ID" "$DEPENDENCY_WORKFLOW_ID" "$PROFILE_WORKFLOW_ID" "$CAPABILITY_WORKFLOW_ID"; do
  [[ "$WORKFLOW_ID" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]
done
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$CODEQL_WORKFLOW_ID" "$DEPENDENCY_WORKFLOW_ID" "$PROFILE_WORKFLOW_ID" "$CAPABILITY_WORKFLOW_ID" | LC_ALL=C sort -u | wc -l)" = "4"

COMPLETE=false
for ATTEMPT in $(seq 1 60); do
  RUNS="$(gh api "repos/${TARGET_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs?head_sha=${HEAD_SHA}&event=pull_request&per_page=100")"
  RUN_COUNT="$(jq -r .total_count <<<"$RUNS")"
  [[ "$RUN_COUNT" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]
  if [ "$RUN_COUNT" -lt 3 ]; then
    sleep 10
    continue
  fi
  test "$RUN_COUNT" = "3"
  MATCHES="$(jq -c --argjson codeql "$CODEQL_WORKFLOW_ID" --argjson dependency "$DEPENDENCY_WORKFLOW_ID" --argjson profile "$PROFILE_WORKFLOW_ID" '[.workflow_runs[] | select(.workflow_id == $codeql or .workflow_id == $dependency or .workflow_id == $profile)]' <<<"$RUNS")"
  test "$(jq 'length' <<<"$MATCHES")" = "3"
  test "$(jq '[.[].workflow_id] | unique | length' <<<"$MATCHES")" = "3"
  jq -e --arg head "$HEAD_SHA" --arg branch "$BRANCH" --arg repo "$TARGET_REPOSITORY" 'all(.[]; .event == "pull_request" and .head_sha == $head and .head_branch == $branch and .head_repository.full_name == $repo)' <<<"$MATCHES" >/dev/null

  COMPLETE=true
  while IFS=$'\t' read -r CHECK_RUN_ID STATUS CONCLUSION; do
    [[ "$CHECK_RUN_ID" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]
    case "$STATUS:$CONCLUSION" in
      completed:success)
        ;;
      completed:action_required|completed:waiting)
        gh api --method POST "repos/${TARGET_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/${CHECK_RUN_ID}/approve" >/dev/null
        COMPLETE=false
        ;;
      queued:null|in_progress:null|waiting:null|pending:null)
        COMPLETE=false
        ;;
      *)
        echo "ERROR: exact Autofix protected workflow entered forbidden state: ${STATUS}:${CONCLUSION}" >&2
        exit 1
        ;;
    esac
  done < <(jq -r '.[] | [.id, .status, (.conclusion // "null")] | @tsv' <<<"$MATCHES")
  if [ "$COMPLETE" = "true" ]; then
    break
  fi
  sleep 10
done
test "$COMPLETE" = "true"

CAPABILITY_COMPLETE=false
for ATTEMPT in $(seq 1 60); do
  CAPABILITY_RUNS="$(gh api "repos/${TARGET_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs?head_sha=${HEAD_SHA}&event=workflow_run&per_page=100")"
  CAPABILITY_MATCHES="$(jq -c --argjson workflow "$CAPABILITY_WORKFLOW_ID" '[.workflow_runs[] | select(.workflow_id == $workflow)]' <<<"$CAPABILITY_RUNS")"
  test "$(jq 'length' <<<"$CAPABILITY_MATCHES")" -le 1
  if [ "$(jq 'length' <<<"$CAPABILITY_MATCHES")" = "0" ]; then
    sleep 10
    continue
  fi
  jq -e --arg head "$HEAD_SHA" --arg branch "$BRANCH" --arg repo "$TARGET_REPOSITORY" '.[0].event == "workflow_run" and .[0].head_sha == $head and .[0].head_branch == $branch and .[0].head_repository.full_name == $repo' <<<"$CAPABILITY_MATCHES" >/dev/null
  CAPABILITY_STATUS="$(jq -r '.[0].status' <<<"$CAPABILITY_MATCHES")"
  CAPABILITY_CONCLUSION="$(jq -r '(.[0].conclusion // "null")' <<<"$CAPABILITY_MATCHES")"
  case "$CAPABILITY_STATUS:$CAPABILITY_CONCLUSION" in
    completed:success)
      CAPABILITY_COMPLETE=true
      break
      ;;
    queued:null|in_progress:null|waiting:null|pending:null)
      ;;
    *)
      echo "ERROR: trusted capability admission entered forbidden state: ${CAPABILITY_STATUS}:${CAPABILITY_CONCLUSION}" >&2
      exit 1
      ;;
  esac
  sleep 10
done
test "$CAPABILITY_COMPLETE" = "true"

steps.name: Verify an existing Autofix PR and perform protected merge
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
test "$TARGET_REPOSITORY" = "portyu9/portyu9"
[[ "$BASE_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
test "$ALERT_NUMBER" -gt 0

PR_NUMBER=""
ORIGIN_RUN_ID=""
HEAD_SHA=""
if [ "$EXISTS" = "true" ]; then
  PR_NUMBER="$EXISTING_PR_NUMBER"
  ORIGIN_RUN_ID="$EXISTING_ORIGIN_RUN_ID"
  HEAD_SHA="$EXISTING_HEAD_SHA"
elif [ "$CREATED" = "true" ]; then
  PR_NUMBER="$CREATED_PR_NUMBER"
  ORIGIN_RUN_ID="$CURRENT_RUN_ID"
  HEAD_SHA="$CREATED_HEAD_SHA"
else
  exit 0
fi
test "$PR_NUMBER" -gt 0
test "$ORIGIN_RUN_ID" -gt 0
[[ "$HEAD_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]

PR="$(gh api "repos/${TARGET_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}")"
test "$(jq -r .state <<<"$PR")" = "open"
test "$(jq -r .draft <<<"$PR")" = "false"
test "$(jq -r .user.login <<<"$PR")" = "github-actions[bot]"
test "$(jq -r .base.ref <<<"$PR")" = "main"
test "$(jq -r .base.sha <<<"$PR")" = "$BASE_SHA"
test "$(jq -r .head.sha <<<"$PR")" = "$HEAD_SHA"
test "$(jq -r .head.repo.full_name <<<"$PR")" = "$TARGET_REPOSITORY"
BRANCH="codeql-autofix/alert-${ALERT_NUMBER}/run-${ORIGIN_RUN_ID}"
test "$(jq -r .head.ref <<<"$PR")" = "$BRANCH"
test "$(gh api "repos/${TARGET_REPOSITORY}/git/ref/heads/${BRANCH}" --jq .object.sha)" = "$HEAD_SHA"
test "$(gh api "repos/${TARGET_REPOSITORY}/git/ref/heads/main" --jq .object.sha)" = "$BASE_SHA"

COMPARE="$(gh api "repos/${TARGET_REPOSITORY}/compare/${BASE_SHA}...${HEAD_SHA}")"
printf '%s\n' "$COMPARE" > verify-compare.json
python3 scripts/codeql_autofix_controller.py compare \
  --compare-file verify-compare.json \
  --base-sha "$BASE_SHA" \
  --head-sha "$HEAD_SHA" \
  --out verify-compare-proof.json

ORIGIN_RUN="$(gh api "repos/${TARGET_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/${ORIGIN_RUN_ID}")"
test "$(jq -r .name <<<"$ORIGIN_RUN")" = "CodeQL Autofix controller"
test "$(jq -r .event <<<"$ORIGIN_RUN")" = "workflow_run" -o "$(jq -r .event <<<"$ORIGIN_RUN")" = "schedule" -o "$(jq -r .event <<<"$ORIGIN_RUN")" = "repository_dispatch"
test "$(jq -r .head_sha <<<"$ORIGIN_RUN")" = "$BASE_SHA"
RECEIPT_NAME="codeql-autofix-receipt-run-${ORIGIN_RUN_ID}-alert-${ALERT_NUMBER}"
ARTIFACTS="$(gh api "repos/${TARGET_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/${ORIGIN_RUN_ID}/artifacts?per_page=100")"
RECEIPT_ARTIFACT="$(jq -c --arg name "$RECEIPT_NAME" '[.artifacts[] | select(.name == $name and .expired == false)]' <<<"$ARTIFACTS")"
test "$(jq 'length' <<<"$RECEIPT_ARTIFACT")" = "1"
ARTIFACT_ID="$(jq -r '.[0].id' <<<"$RECEIPT_ARTIFACT")"
test "$ARTIFACT_ID" -gt 0
rm -rf receipt-download
mkdir -p receipt-download
gh api "repos/${TARGET_REPOSITORY}/actions/artifacts/${ARTIFACT_ID}/zip" > receipt.zip
unzip -q receipt.zip -d receipt-download
test -f receipt-download/codeql-autofix-receipt.json
test ! -L receipt-download/codeql-autofix-receipt.json
test "$(find receipt-download -maxdepth 1 -type f | wc -l)" = "1"
RECEIPT_RUN_ID="$(jq -r .runId receipt-download/codeql-autofix-receipt.json)"
RECEIPT_RUN_ATTEMPT="$(jq -r .runAttempt receipt-download/codeql-autofix-receipt.json)"
test "$RECEIPT_RUN_ID" = "$ORIGIN_RUN_ID"
test "$RECEIPT_RUN_ATTEMPT" -gt 0
ORIGIN_ATTEMPT_RUN="$(gh api "repos/${TARGET_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/${ORIGIN_RUN_ID}/attempts/${RECEIPT_RUN_ATTEMPT}")"
printf '%s\n' "$ORIGIN_ATTEMPT_RUN" > origin-run.json
python3 scripts/codeql_autofix_controller.py verify-receipt \
  --receipt-file receipt-download/codeql-autofix-receipt.json \
  --origin-run-file origin-run.json \
  --current-repository "$TARGET_REPOSITORY" \
  --current-base-sha "$BASE_SHA" \
  --current-alert "$ALERT_NUMBER" \
  --current-pr-number "$PR_NUMBER" \
  --current-branch "$BRANCH" \
  --current-head-sha "$HEAD_SHA" \
  --out receipt-proof.json

python3 scripts/codeql_autofix_controller.py changed-files \
  --pr-number "$PR_NUMBER" \
  --compare-file verify-compare.json \
  --base-sha "$BASE_SHA" \
  --head-sha "$HEAD_SHA" \
  --out changed-files.json

gh api --paginate --slurp \
  "repos/${TARGET_REPOSITORY}/commits/${HEAD_SHA}/check-runs?per_page=100" \
  > check-pages.json
python3 scripts/codeql_autofix_controller.py checks \
  --check-pages-file check-pages.json \
  --required validate-contracts \
  --required trusted-capability-admission \
  --required integration-pinned-upstream \
  --required dependency-review \
  --required analyze-actions \
  --required analyze-python \
  --expected-app-id 15368 \
  --codeql-app-id 57789 \
  --out check-proof.json

gh api --paginate --slurp \
  "repos/${TARGET_REPOSITORY}/code-scanning/alerts?state=open&tool_name=CodeQL&ref=refs/pull/${PR_NUMBER}/merge&per_page=100" \
  > pr-alert-pages.json
gh api --paginate --slurp \
  "repos/${TARGET_REPOSITORY}/code-scanning/alerts?state=open&tool_name=CodeQL&per_page=100" \
  > current-open-alert-pages.json
python3 scripts/codeql_autofix_controller.py alerts-proof \
  --target-file target.json \
  --pr-alerts-file pr-alert-pages.json \
  --open-alerts-file current-open-alert-pages.json \
  --head-sha "$HEAD_SHA" \
  --out alert-proof.json

gh api graphql \
  -f query='query($owner:String!,$name:String!,$number:Int!){repository(owner:$owner,name:$name){pullRequest(number:$number){reviewThreads(first:100){nodes{isResolved}}}}}' \
  -f owner=portyu9 \
  -f name=portyu9 \
  -F number="$PR_NUMBER" \
  > review-threads.json
python3 scripts/codeql_autofix_controller.py reviews \
  --threads-file review-threads.json \
  --out review-proof.json

FINAL_PR="$(gh api "repos/${TARGET_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}")"
test "$(jq -r .state <<<"$FINAL_PR")" = "open"
test "$(jq -r .draft <<<"$FINAL_PR")" = "false"
test "$(jq -r .base.sha <<<"$FINAL_PR")" = "$BASE_SHA"
test "$(jq -r .head.sha <<<"$FINAL_PR")" = "$HEAD_SHA"
test "$(gh api "repos/${TARGET_REPOSITORY}/git/ref/heads/main" --jq .object.sha)" = "$BASE_SHA"
test "$(gh api "repos/${TARGET_REPOSITORY}/git/ref/heads/${BRANCH}" --jq .object.sha)" = "$HEAD_SHA"

gh api --method PUT \
  "repos/${TARGET_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}/merge" \
  -f merge_method=merge \
  -f sha="$HEAD_SHA" \
  -f commit_title="CodeQL Autofix alert #${ALERT_NUMBER} (#${PR_NUMBER})" \
  -f commit_message="Protected autonomous merge after exact-head CodeQL Autofix admission." \
  > merge-result.json
test "$(jq -r .merged merge-result.json)" = "true"
MERGE_SHA="$(jq -r .sha merge-result.json)"
[[ "$MERGE_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
test "$(gh api "repos/${TARGET_REPOSITORY}/git/ref/heads/main" --jq .object.sha)" = "$MERGE_SHA"

steps.name: Post Checkout exact trusted default-branch source
